Fee Offer

  • Zero Insurance Fee (CLI)

Bundle Offer

  • First Year Free Card with Eligible Miles / Points
  • Overdraft (OD) with First Year Free Setup (Nil First Year Set Up Fee)

Conditions

  • Applicable only to employees working with the Mubadala Group and have STL relationship with Emirates NBD
  • Applicable for Fresh, Top Up & Take Over Loans (not applicable for PCL Loans)
  • Standard Processing Fees shall apply
  • Minimum income of  15,000
  • Minimum Loan amount for FRESH and TAKEOVER Loan is  200,000
  • Minimum Cash out amount for TOPUP Loan is  100,000
  • Promotion is not valid in conjunction with any other offers / promotions / campaigns
  • Minimum AECB score of 600
  • Standard Credit Policy norms shall apply
  • Use Promo Code: PL NATIONALMUBADALA for UAE Nationals and PL EXPATMUBADALA for Expats
  • Valid until 31st October 2025

Credit Cards


Priority Banking Visa Infinite – First year free

Etihad Guest Visa Elevate – First year free

  • Earn 40,000 Miles upon activation (for Salary Transfer customers only)
  • Earn 60,000 Miles upon spending minimum  90,000 within 6 months from card issuance date
  • Earn 100,000 Miles upon spending minimum  120,000 within 6 months from card issuance date

Skywards Infinite – First year free

  • 35,000 Skywards Miles upon activation (for Salary Transfer customers only)
  • 40,000 Skywards Miles on spending minimum USD 25,000 within the first three billing statements
  • 25,000 Skywards Miles on spending minimum USD 7,500 on emirates.com or at any Emirates sales office in the UAE within the first twelve billing statement

Darna Credit Cards

  • Darna Select – Free for life
  • Darna Infinite - Spend bonus of 7500 Darna points ( 750 cashback in Aldar venues) upon spending  20,000 in first 3 months
